title.raw: 卷11 志第6 禮儀六 Volume 11 Treatises 6: Rites 6

sentences.zh: 禮儀六

translations.literal: Rites, Part Six.
translations.idiomatic: Rites, Part Six

sentences.zh: 梁制，乘輿郊天、祀地、禮明堂、祠宗廟、元會臨軒，則黑介幘，通天冠平冕，俗所謂平天冠者也。

translations.literal: Under Liang regulations, when the emperor performed suburban sacrifice to Heaven, sacrifice to Earth, rites at the Bright Hall, sacrifice at the ancestral temple, or the New Year's assembly at the imperial throne, he wore a black jie cap, tongtian cap, and flat crown—the popularly so-called flat heaven cap.
translations.idiomatic: Under Liang regulations, when the emperor performed suburban sacrifice to Heaven, sacrifice to Earth, rites at the Bright Hall, sacrifice at the ancestral temple, or the New Year's assembly at the imperial throne, he wore a black jie cap with the tongtian cap and flat crown—the so-called flat heaven cap.

sentences.zh: 其制，玄表，朱綠裡，廣七寸，長尺二寸，加于通天冠上。

translations.literal: Its form: black exterior, vermilion-green lining, seven cun wide, one chi two cun long, placed atop the tongtian cap.
translations.idiomatic: Its form was a black exterior with vermilion-green lining, seven cun wide and one chi two cun long, placed atop the tongtian cap.

sentences.zh: 前垂四寸，後垂三寸，前圓而後方。

translations.literal: It hung four cun in front and three cun behind, round in front and square behind.
translations.idiomatic: It hung four cun in front and three cun behind, round in front and square behind.

sentences.zh: 垂白玉珠，十有二旒，其長齊肩。

translations.literal: White jade beads hung down; there were twelve tassels, their length reaching the shoulders.
translations.idiomatic: White jade beads hung down in twelve tassels, their length reaching the shoulders.

sentences.zh: 以組為纓，各如其綬色，傍垂黈纊，珫珠以玉瑱。

translations.literal: Silk cords served as the chin strap, each matching the color of its sash; at the sides hung yellow tassels, with jade plugs for the bead strings.
translations.idiomatic: Silk cords served as the chin strap, each matching the color of its sash; yellow tassels hung at the sides, with jade plugs securing the bead strings.

sentences.zh: 其衣，皁上絳下，前三幅，後四幅。

translations.literal: The robe: black above and cinnabar below, three panels in front and four in back.
translations.idiomatic: The robe was black above and cinnabar below, with three panels in front and four in back.

sentences.zh: 衣畫而裳繡。

translations.literal: The upper garment was painted; the lower skirt was embroidered.
translations.idiomatic: The upper garment was painted; the lower skirt was embroidered.

sentences.zh: 衣則日、月、星辰、山、龍、華蟲、火、宗彝，畫以為繢。

translations.literal: On the robe were the sun, moon, stars, mountain, dragon, embroidered insects, fire, and ancestral vessels, painted as ornament.
translations.idiomatic: The robe bore the sun, moon, stars, mountain, dragon, embroidered insects, fire, and ancestral vessels, painted as ornament.

sentences.zh: 裳則藻、粉、米、黼黻，以為繡。

translations.literal: On the skirt were waterweed, grain, rice, and the fu and fe patterns, worked as embroidery.
translations.idiomatic: The skirt bore waterweed, grain, rice, and the fu and fe patterns, worked as embroidery.

sentences.zh: 凡十二章。

translations.literal: In all, twelve chapters.
translations.idiomatic: In all, there were twelve emblems.

sentences.zh: 素帶，廣四寸，朱裡，以朱繡裨飾其側。

translations.literal: A plain sash, four cun wide, with vermilion lining, and vermilion embroidered trim at the sides.
translations.idiomatic: A plain sash four cun wide, with vermilion lining and vermilion embroidered trim at the sides.

sentences.zh: 中衣以絳緣領袖。

translations.literal: The inner robe had cinnabar trim at collar and sleeves.
translations.idiomatic: The inner robe had cinnabar trim at the collar and sleeves.

sentences.zh: 赤皮為韠，蓋古之韍也。

translations.literal: Red leather served as the knee cover—essentially the ancient fu.
translations.idiomatic: Red leather served as the knee cover—essentially the ancient fu.

sentences.zh: 絳袴襪，赤舄。

translations.literal: Cinnabar trousers and socks, red shoes.
translations.idiomatic: Cinnabar trousers and socks, with red shoes.

sentences.zh: 佩白玉，垂朱黃大綬，黃赤縹紺四采，革帶，帶劍，緄帶以組為之，如綬色。

translations.literal: He wore white jade at the belt, with a great sash of vermilion and yellow hanging down, in four colors of yellow, red, light blue, and dark blue; a leather belt, sword at the belt, and a wrapped belt made of cords matching the sash colors.
translations.idiomatic: He wore white jade at the belt, with a great sash of vermilion and yellow hanging down in four colors—yellow, red, light blue, and dark blue; a leather belt with sword, and a wrapped belt of cords matching the sash colors.

sentences.zh: 黃金辟邪首為帶鐍，而飾以白玉珠。

translations.literal: A gold ward-off-evil head served as the belt buckle, ornamented with white jade beads.
translations.idiomatic: A gold ward-off-evil head served as the belt buckle, ornamented with white jade beads.

sentences.zh: 又有通天冠，高九寸，前加金博山、述，黑介幘，絳紗袍，皁緣中衣，黑舄，是為朝服。

translations.literal: There was also the tongtian cap, nine cun high, with a gold Boshan ornament and shu in front, black jie cap, cinnabar gauze robe, black-trimmed inner robe, black shoes—this was court dress.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the tongtian cap, nine cun high, with a gold Boshan ornament and shu in front, black jie cap, cinnabar gauze robe, black-trimmed inner robe, and black shoes—this was court dress.

sentences.zh: 元正賀畢，還儲更衣，出所服也。

translations.literal: When New Year's congratulations were finished, he returned to the storehouse to change clothes and put on what he had brought out.
translations.idiomatic: When New Year's congratulations were finished, he returned to the storehouse to change clothes and put on what he had brought out.

sentences.zh: 其釋奠先聖，則皁紗袍，絳緣中衣，絳袴襪，黑舄。

translations.literal: For the libation sacrifice to the sage, he wore a black gauze robe, cinnabar-trimmed inner robe, cinnabar trousers and socks, and black shoes.
translations.idiomatic: For the libation sacrifice to the sage, he wore a black gauze robe, cinnabar-trimmed inner robe, cinnabar trousers and socks, and black shoes.

sentences.zh: 臨軒亦服袞冕，未加元服，則空頂介幘。

translations.literal: At the imperial throne he also wore the dragon robe and crown; before receiving the capping ceremony, he wore the open-topped jie cap.
translations.idiomatic: At the imperial throne he also wore the dragon robe and crown; before receiving the capping ceremony, he wore the open-topped jie cap.

sentences.zh: 拜陵則箋布單衣，介幘。

translations.literal: When paying respects at the imperial tombs, he wore a single garment of fine cloth and a jie cap.
translations.idiomatic: When paying respects at the imperial tombs, he wore a single garment of fine cloth and a jie cap.

sentences.zh: 又有五梁進賢冠、遠遊、平上幘武冠。

translations.literal: There were also the five-ribbed advance-the-worthy cap, far-wandering cap, flat-top cap, and military cap.
translations.idiomatic: There were also the five-ribbed advance-the-worthy cap, far-wandering cap, flat-top cap, and military cap.

sentences.zh: 單衣，黑介幘，宴會則服之。

translations.literal: Single garment, black jie cap—worn at banquets.
translations.idiomatic: A single garment with black jie cap—worn at banquets.

sentences.zh: 單衣、白帢，以代古之疑衰、皮弁為吊服，為群臣舉哀臨喪則服之。

translations.literal: Single garment and white cap, replacing the ancient si mourning robe and leather cap as mourning dress; when ministers expressed mourning and attended funerals, they wore it.
translations.idiomatic: A single garment and white cap replaced the ancient si mourning robe and leather cap as mourning dress; when ministers expressed mourning and attended funerals, they wore this.

sentences.zh: 天監三年，何佟之議：「公卿以下祭服，裡有中衣，即今之中單也。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianjian, He Tongzhi proposed: "Below the rank of duke and minister, sacrificial dress has an inner robe within—the present-day inner single garment.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tianjian, He Tongzhi proposed: "Below the rank of duke and minister, sacrificial dress includes an inner robe—the present-day inner single garment.

sentences.zh: 案後漢《輿服志》明帝永平二年，初詔有司采《周官》、《禮記》、《尚書》，乘輿服，從歐陽說；

translations.literal: Examining the Later Han "Regulations of Carriages and Robes," in the second year of Yongping under Emperor Ming, an initial edict ordered the relevant offices to adopt the "Offices of Zhou," "Record of Rites," and "Documents" for imperial carriage and robe regulations, following Ouyang's interpretation;
translations.idiomatic: Examining the Later Han "Regulations of Carriages and Robes," in the second year of Yongping under Emperor Ming, an initial edict ordered the relevant offices to adopt the "Offices of Zhou," "Record of Rites," and "Documents" for imperial carriage and robe regulations, following Ouyang's interpretation;

sentences.zh: 公卿以下服，從大小夏侯說。

translations.literal: For robes below the rank of duke and minister, they followed the interpretations of the Elder and Younger Xiahou.
translations.idiomatic: For robes below the rank of duke and minister, they followed the interpretations of the Elder and Younger Xiahou.

sentences.zh: 祭服，絳緣領袖為中衣，絳袴襪，示其赤心奉神。

translations.literal: For sacrificial dress, cinnabar trim at collar and sleeves served as the inner robe, with cinnabar trousers and socks, showing the red heart in serving the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: For sacrificial dress, cinnabar trim at collar and sleeves served as the inner robe, with cinnabar trousers and socks, showing the red heart in serving the spirits.

sentences.zh: 今中衣絳緣，足有所明，無俟於袴。

translations.literal: Now the inner robe has cinnabar trim, which is sufficiently clear in itself; there is no need for trousers.
translations.idiomatic: Now the inner robe has cinnabar trim, which is sufficiently clear in itself; there is no need for the trousers.

sentences.zh: 既非聖法，謂不可施。

translations.literal: Since this is not the sage's law, it should not be applied.
translations.idiomatic: Since this is not the sage's law, it should not be applied.

sentences.zh: 」遂依議除之。

translations.literal: " Thereupon they followed the proposal and removed it.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon they followed the proposal and removed it.

sentences.zh: 四年，有司言：平天冠等一百五條，自齊以來，隨故而毀，未詳所送。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the relevant offices reported: one hundred five items such as the flat heaven cap, since Qi had been destroyed piecemeal with the changing times, and it was unclear where they had been sent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, the relevant offices reported that one hundred five items such as the flat heaven cap, since Qi, had been destroyed piecemeal with the changing times, and it was unclear where they had been sent.

sentences.zh: 何佟之議：「《禮》『祭服敝則焚之』。

translations.literal: He Tongzhi proposed: "The Rites say, 'When sacrificial robes are worn out, burn them.'
translations.idiomatic: He Tongzhi proposed: "The Rites say, 'When sacrificial robes are worn out, burn them.'

sentences.zh: 」於是並燒除之，其珠玉以付中署。

translations.literal: " Thereupon they were all burned and removed; the pearls and jade were handed over to the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon they were all burned and removed; the pearls and jade were handed over to the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 七年，周舍議：「詔旨以王者袞服，宜畫鳳皇，以示差降。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Zhou She proposed: "The edict holds that the king's dragon robe should be painted with the phoenix, to show the gradation of rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Zhou She proposed: "The edict holds that the king's dragon robe should be painted with the phoenix, to show the gradation of rank.

sentences.zh: 按《禮》：『有虞氏皇而祭，深衣而養老。

translations.literal: Examining the Rites: 'The Youyu clan wore the huang robe for sacrifice and deep robes for nurturing the aged.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the Rites: 'The Youyu clan wore the huang robe for sacrifice and deep robes for nurturing the aged.

sentences.zh: 』鄭玄所言皇，則是畫鳳皇羽也。

translations.literal: ' What Zheng Xuan called huang was the painting of phoenix feathers.
translations.idiomatic: ' What Zheng Xuan called huang was the painting of phoenix feathers.

sentences.zh: 又按《禮》所稱雜服，皆以衣定名，猶如袞冕，則是袞衣而冕。

translations.literal: Further examining the miscellaneous robes mentioned in the Rites, all are named by the garment, just as dragon robe and crown means dragon robe with crown.
translations.idiomatic: Further examining the miscellaneous robes mentioned in the Rites, all are named by the garment, just as dragon robe and crown means dragon robe with crown.

sentences.zh: 明有虞言皇者，是衣名，非冕，明矣。

translations.literal: Clearly when Youyu speaks of huang, it is a garment name, not a crown—this is obvious.
translations.idiomatic: Clearly when Youyu speaks of huang, it is a garment name, not a crown—this is obvious.

sentences.zh: 畫鳳之旨，事實灼然。

translations.literal: The intent to paint the phoenix is in fact clear.
translations.idiomatic: The intent to paint the phoenix is in fact clear.

translations.literal: " The regulation: "Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The regulation: "Approved.

sentences.zh: 」又王僧崇云：「今祭服，三公衣身畫獸，其腰及袖，又有青獸，形與獸同，義應是蜼，即宗彝也。

translations.literal: " Also Wang Sengchong said: "Present sacrificial dress: the three dukes' robes have beasts painted on the body; at the waist and sleeves there are also green beasts, the same form as the beasts—the meaning should be the wei, that is, the ancestral vessel emblem.
translations.idiomatic: " Also Wang Sengchong said: "In present sacrificial dress, the three dukes' robes have beasts painted on the body; at the waist and sleeves there are also green beasts, the same form as the beasts—the meaning should be the wei, that is, the ancestral vessel emblem.

sentences.zh: 兩袖各有禽鳥，形類鸞鳳，似是華蟲。

translations.literal: Each sleeve has a bird, resembling the luan and phoenix—seemingly the embroidered insect emblem.
translations.idiomatic: Each sleeve has a bird, resembling the luan and phoenix—seemingly the embroidered insect emblem.

sentences.zh: 今畫宗彝，即是周禮。

translations.literal: To paint the ancestral vessel emblem now is precisely the Rites of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: To paint the ancestral vessel emblem now is precisely the Rites of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 但鄭玄云：『蜼，𧍪屬，昂鼻長尾。

translations.literal: But Zheng Xuan said: 'The wei is of the monkey kind, with upturned nose and long tail.
translations.idiomatic: But Zheng Xuan said: 'The wei is of the monkey kind, with upturned nose and long tail.

sentences.zh: 』是獸之輕小者，謂宜不得同獸。

translations.literal: ' It is a small light beast; it should not be the same as the beasts.
translations.idiomatic: ' It is a small light beast; it should not be depicted the same as the beasts.

sentences.zh: 尋冕服無鳳，應改為雉。

translations.literal: Searching the crown robes, there is no phoenix; it should be changed to pheasant.
translations.idiomatic: Searching the crown robes, there is no phoenix; it should be changed to pheasant.

sentences.zh: 又裳有圓花，於禮無礙，疑是畫師加葩Ｌ耳。

translations.literal: Also the skirt has round flowers, which in ritual is no obstacle—likely the painter added flourishes.
translations.idiomatic: Also the skirt has round flowers, which in ritual is no obstacle—likely the painter added flourishes.

sentences.zh: 藻米黼黻，並乖古制，今請改正，並去圓花。

translations.literal: Waterweed, grain, fu, and fe all depart from ancient regulations; we now request correction and removal of the round flowers.
translations.idiomatic: Waterweed, grain, fu, and fe all depart from ancient regulations; we now request correction and removal of the round flowers.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「古文日月星辰，此以一辰攝三物也。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "In the ancient text, sun, moon, and stars—here one constellation emblem represents three things.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "In the ancient text, sun, moon, and stars—here one constellation emblem represents three things.

sentences.zh: 山龍華蟲，又以一山攝三物也。

translations.literal: Mountain, dragon, and embroidered insect—again one mountain emblem represents three things.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain, dragon, and embroidered insect—again one mountain emblem represents three things.

sentences.zh: 藻火粉米，又以一藻攝三物也。

translations.literal: Waterweed, fire, and grain—again one waterweed emblem represents three things.
translations.idiomatic: Waterweed, fire, and grain—again one waterweed emblem represents three things.

sentences.zh: 是為九章。

translations.literal: This makes nine chapters.
translations.idiomatic: This makes nine emblems.

sentences.zh: 今袞服畫龍，則宜應畫鳳明矣。

translations.literal: Now the dragon robe is painted with dragons; it should accordingly be painted with phoenixes—this is clear.
translations.idiomatic: Now the dragon robe is painted with dragons; it should accordingly be painted with phoenixes—this is clear.

sentences.zh: 孔安國云：『華者，花也。

translations.literal: Kong Anguo said: 'Hua means flower.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Anguo said: 'Hua means flower.

sentences.zh: 』則為花非疑。

translations.literal: ' Then it is flower, not in doubt.
translations.idiomatic: ' Then it is flower, not in doubt.

sentences.zh: 若一向畫雉，差降之文，復將安寄？

translations.literal: If one uniformly paints pheasants, where shall the text of gradation be placed?
translations.idiomatic: If one uniformly paints pheasants, where shall the text of gradation be placed?

sentences.zh: 鄭義是所未允。

translations.literal: Zheng's interpretation is what I cannot accept.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng's interpretation is what I cannot accept.

sentences.zh: 」又帝曰：「《禮》：『王者祀昊天上帝，則大裘而冕，祀五帝亦如之。

translations.literal: " Also the emperor said: "The Rites: 'When the king sacrifices to the Supreme God of Heaven, he wears the great fur robe and crown; sacrificing to the Five Emperors is the same.
translations.idiomatic: " Also the emperor said: "The Rites: 'When the king sacrifices to the Supreme God of Heaven, he wears the great fur robe and crown; sacrificing to the Five Emperors is the same.

sentences.zh: 』又云：『莞席之安，而蒲越稿秸之用。

translations.literal: ' It also says: 'The comfort of rush matting, yet the use of rush fringe and straw padding.
translations.idiomatic: ' It also says: 'The comfort of rush matting, yet the use of rush fringe and straw padding.

sentences.zh: 』斯皆至敬無文，貴誠重質。

translations.literal: ' These all express utmost reverence without ornament, valuing sincerity and substance.
translations.idiomatic: ' These all express utmost reverence without ornament, valuing sincerity and substance.

sentences.zh: 今郊用陶匏，與古不異，而大裘蒲秸，獨不復存，其於質敬，恐有未盡。

translations.literal: Now at the suburban sacrifice earthenware and gourds are used, no different from antiquity, yet the great fur robe and rush straw padding alone are no longer preserved—in sincerity and reverence, I fear this is incomplete.
translations.idiomatic: Now at the suburban sacrifice earthenware and gourds are used, no different from antiquity, yet the great fur robe and rush straw padding alone are no longer preserved—in sincerity and reverence, I fear this is incomplete.

sentences.zh: 且一獻為質，其劍佩之飾及公卿所著冕服，可共詳定。

translations.literal: Moreover, the first offering is substance; the sword and girdle ornaments and the crown robes worn by dukes and ministers can be jointly determined in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the first offering is substance; the sword and girdle ornaments and the crown robes worn by dukes and ministers can be jointly determined in detail.

sentences.zh: 」五經博士陸瑋等並云：「祭天猶存掃地之質，而服章獨取黼黻為文，於義不可。

translations.literal: " The Five Classics erudites Lu Wei and others all said: "Sacrificing to Heaven still preserves the substance of sweeping the ground, yet the robe insignia alone takes fu and fe as ornament—in meaning this is wrong.
translations.idiomatic: " The Five Classics erudites Lu Wei and others all said: "Sacrificing to Heaven still preserves the substance of sweeping the ground, yet the robe insignia alone takes fu and fe as ornament—in meaning this is wrong.

sentences.zh: 今南郊神座，皆用嵒席，此獨莞類，未盡質素之理。

translations.literal: Now at the southern suburban spirit seats, all use rush mats—this alone is of the rush kind; the principle of plain substance is not fully realized.
translations.idiomatic: Now at the southern suburban spirit seats, all use rush mats—this alone is of the rush kind; the principle of plain substance is not fully realized.

sentences.zh: 宜以稿秸為下藉，蒲越為上席。

translations.literal: Straw padding should serve as the lower mat, and rush fringe as the upper mat.
translations.idiomatic: Straw padding should serve as the lower mat, and rush fringe as the upper mat.

sentences.zh: 又《司服》云：『王祀昊天，服大裘』，明諸臣禮不得同。

translations.literal: Also the "Director of Robes" says: 'When the king sacrifices to the Supreme Heaven, he wears the great fur robe'—showing that ministers' rites cannot be the same.
translations.idiomatic: Also the "Director of Robes" says: 'When the king sacrifices to the Supreme Heaven, he wears the great fur robe'—showing that ministers' rites cannot be the same.

sentences.zh: 自魏以來，皆用袞服，今請依古，更制大裘。

translations.literal: Since Wei, all have used the dragon robe; we now request following antiquity and newly making the great fur robe.
translations.idiomatic: Since Wei, all have used the dragon robe; we now request following antiquity and newly making the great fur robe.

translations.literal: " The regulation: "Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The regulation: "Approved.

sentences.zh: 」瑋等又尋大裘之制，唯鄭玄注《司服》云「大裘，羔裘也」，既無所出，未可為據。

translations.literal: " Wei and others further searched the regulations for the great fur robe; only Zheng Xuan's commentary on the "Director of Robes" says "great fur robe, lamb fur robe"—since there is no source, it cannot serve as evidence.
translations.idiomatic: " Wei and others further searched the regulations for the great fur robe; only Zheng Xuan's commentary on the "Director of Robes" says "great fur robe, lamb fur robe"—since there is no source, it cannot serve as evidence.

sentences.zh: 案六冕之服，皆玄上纁下。

translations.literal: Examining the six crown robes, all are black above and vermilion below.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the six crown robes, all are black above and vermilion below.

sentences.zh: 今宜以玄繒為之。

translations.literal: Now it should be made of black silk.
translations.idiomatic: Now it should be made of black silk.

sentences.zh: 其制式如裘，其裳以纁，皆無文繡。

translations.literal: Its form like a fur robe, its skirt vermilion, all without patterned embroidery.
translations.idiomatic: Its form like a fur robe, its skirt vermilion, all without patterned embroidery.

sentences.zh: 冕則無旒。

translations.literal: The crown then has no tassels.
translations.idiomatic: The crown then has no tassels.

translations.literal: Edict: "Approved."
translations.idiomatic: Edict: "Approved."

sentences.zh: 又乘輿宴會，服單衣，黑介幘。

translations.literal: Also at imperial banquets, he wore a single garment and black jie cap.
translations.idiomatic: Also at imperial banquets, he wore a single garment and black jie cap.

sentences.zh: 舊三日九日小會，初出乘金輅服之。

translations.literal: Formerly at the third- and ninth-day minor assemblies, when first going out he rode the gold chariot and wore this.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly at the third- and ninth-day minor assemblies, when first going out he rode the gold chariot and wore this.

sentences.zh: 八年，帝改去還皆乘輦，服白紗帽。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the emperor changed so that going and returning he always rode the palanquin and wore a white gauze cap.

translations.idiomatic: By Xiping 2, Grand Tutor Prince Qinghe Yi, Attendant of the Yellow Gate Wei Tingxiang, and others memorialized fixing five-season court dress, following Han precedent, Five Suburbs caps and headcloths each according to directional color.

sentences.zh: 及後齊因之。

translations.literal: Later Qi followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Later Qi followed this.

sentences.zh: 河清中，改易舊物，著令定制云。

translations.literal: Heqing middle, changed old objects, recorded fixed regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Heqing middle, changed old objects, recorded fixed regulations.

sentences.zh: 乘輿，平冕，黑介幘，垂白珠十二旒，飾以五采玉，以組為纓，色如其綬，黈纊，玉笄。

translations.literal: Imperial carriage: flat crown, black jie cap, hanging white pearl twelve tassels, ornamented with five-color jade, cords as chin strap color like sash, yellow tassels, jade hairpin.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial carriage: flat crown, black jie cap, hanging white pearl twelve tassels, ornamented with five-color jade, cords as chin strap color like sash, yellow tassels, jade hairpin.

sentences.zh: 白玉璽，黃赤綬，五采，黃赤縹綠紺，純黃質，長二丈九尺，五百首，廣一尺二寸。

translations.literal: White jade seal, yellow-red sash, five colors, yellow red light blue green dark blue, pure yellow substance, two zhang nine chi long, five hundred tassel, one chi two cun wide.
translations.idiomatic: White jade seal, yellow-red sash, five colors, yellow red light blue green dark blue, pure yellow substance, two zhang nine chi long, five hundred tassel, one chi two cun wide.

sentences.zh: 小綬長三尺二寸，與綬同采，而首半之。

translations.literal: Small sash three chi two cun long, same colors as sash, tassel half.
translations.idiomatic: Small sash three chi two cun long, same colors as sash, tassel half.

sentences.zh: 袞服，皁衣，絳裳，裳前三幅，後四幅，織成為之，十二章，緣絳中單，織成緄帶，朱紱，佩白玉，帶鹿盧劍，絳袴襪，赤舄。

translations.literal: Dragon robe, black robe, cinnabar skirt, skirt three panels front four back, woven complete, twelve emblems, cinnabar-edged inner single garment, woven wrapped belt, vermilion strap, wearing white jade, belt Lulu sword, cinnabar trousers socks, red shoes.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon robe: black robe, cinnabar skirt, skirt three panels front four back, woven complete, twelve emblems, cinnabar-edged inner single garment, woven wrapped belt, vermilion strap, wearing white jade, belt Lulu sword, cinnabar trousers and socks, red shoes.

sentences.zh: 未加元服，則空頂介幘。

translations.literal: Before receiving capping ceremony, then open-topped jie cap.
translations.idiomatic: Before receiving capping ceremony, open-topped jie cap.

sentences.zh: 又有通天金博山冠，則絳紗袍，皁緣中單。

translations.literal: Also tongtian gold Boshan cap, then cinnabar gauze robe, black-trimmed inner robe.
translations.idiomatic: Also tongtian gold Boshan cap, then cinnabar gauze robe, black-trimmed inner robe.

sentences.zh: 其五時服，則五色介幘，進賢五梁冠，五色紗袍。

translations.literal: Five-season dress then five-color jie cap, advance-the-worthy five-ribbed cap, five-color gauze robe.
translations.idiomatic: Five-season dress then five-color jie cap, advance-the-worthy five-ribbed cap, five-color gauze robe.

sentences.zh: 又有遠遊五梁冠，並不通於下。

translations.literal: Also far-wandering five-ribbed cap, both not passed to subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: Also far-wandering five-ribbed cap, both not passed to subordinates.

sentences.zh: 四時祭廟、圓丘、方澤、明堂、五郊、封禪、大雩、出宮行事、正旦受朝及臨軒拜王公，皆服袞冕之服。

translations.literal: Four-season temple sacrifice, Round Mound, Square Pond, Bright Hall, Five Suburbs, feng and shan, great rain prayer, leaving palace on business, New Year receiving court and throne audience bowing to dukes and ministers—all wore dragon robe and crown dress.
translations.idiomatic: Four-season temple sacrifice, Round Mound, Square Pond, Bright Hall, Five Suburbs, feng and shan, great rain prayer, leaving palace on business, New Year receiving court and throne audience bowing to dukes and ministers—all wore dragon robe and crown dress.

sentences.zh: 還宮及齋，則服通天冠。

translations.literal: Returning to palace and fasting, then wore tongtian cap.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to palace and fasting, then wore tongtian cap.

sentences.zh: 籍田則冠冕，璪十二旒，佩蒼玉，黃綬，青帶，青襪，青舄。

translations.literal: Sacred field then crown, twelve tassel gems, wearing dark jade, yellow sash, blue belt, blue socks, blue shoes.
translations.idiomatic: Sacred field then crown, twelve tassel gems, wearing dark jade, yellow sash, blue belt, blue socks, and blue shoes.

sentences.zh: 拜陵則黑介幘，白紗單衣。

translations.literal: Paying respects at tombs then black jie cap, white gauze single garment.
translations.idiomatic: Paying respects at tombs then black jie cap, white gauze single garment.

sentences.zh: 釋奠則服通天金博山冠，玄紗袍。

translations.literal: Libation sacrifice then wore tongtian gold Boshan cap, dark gauze robe.
translations.idiomatic: Libation sacrifice then wore tongtian gold Boshan cap, dark gauze robe.

sentences.zh: 春分朝日，則青紗朝服，青舄，秋分夕月，則白紗朝服，緗舄，俱冠五梁進賢冠。

translations.literal: Spring equinox morning sun then blue gauze court dress, blue shoes; autumn equinox evening moon then white gauze court dress, light red shoes—both five-ribbed advance-the-worthy cap.
translations.idiomatic: Spring equinox morning sun then blue gauze court dress, blue shoes; autumn equinox evening moon then white gauze court dress, light red shoes—both five-ribbed advance-the-worthy cap.

sentences.zh: 合朔，服通天金博山冠，絳紗袍。

translations.literal: New moon then wore tongtian gold Boshan cap, cinnabar gauze robe.
translations.idiomatic: New moon then wore tongtian gold Boshan cap and cinnabar gauze robe.

sentences.zh: 季秋講武、出征告廟，冠武弁，黃金附蟬，左貂。

translations.literal: Autumn ninth month military review, expedition announcing temple: military cap, gold cicada attached, left sable.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn ninth month military review and expedition announcing temple: military cap, gold cicada attached, left sable.

sentences.zh: 祃類宜社，武弁，朱衣。

translations.literal: Ma and lei rites, military cap, vermilion robe.
translations.idiomatic: Ma and lei rites: military cap and vermilion robe.

sentences.zh: 纂嚴升殿，服通天金博山冠，絳紗袍。

translations.literal: Gathering troops ascending hall: tongtian gold Boshan cap, cinnabar gauze robe.
translations.idiomatic: Gathering troops ascending hall: tongtian gold Boshan cap and cinnabar gauze robe.

sentences.zh: 入溫、涼室，冠武弁，右貂附蟬，絳紗服。

translations.literal: Entering warm and cool chambers: military cap, right sable cicada attached, cinnabar gauze dress.
translations.idiomatic: Entering warm and cool chambers: military cap, right sable cicada attached, cinnabar gauze dress.

sentences.zh: 征還飲至，服通天冠。

translations.literal: Campaign return drinking ceremony: tongtian cap.
translations.idiomatic: Campaign return drinking ceremony: tongtian cap.

sentences.zh: 廟中遣上將，則袞冕，還宮則通天金博山冠。

translations.literal: Temple dispatching great general then dragon robe and crown; returning palace then tongtian gold Boshan cap.
translations.idiomatic: Temple dispatching great general then dragon robe and crown; returning palace then tongtian gold Boshan cap.

sentences.zh: 賞祖罰社，則武弁，左貂附蟬。

translations.literal: Rewarding ancestors punishing altars then military cap, left sable cicada attached.
translations.idiomatic: Rewarding ancestors punishing altars then military cap, left sable cicada attached.

sentences.zh: 元日、冬至大小會，皆通天金博山冠。

translations.literal: New Year's Day, winter solstice major and minor assemblies all tongtian gold Boshan cap.
translations.idiomatic: New Year's Day and winter solstice major and minor assemblies all tongtian gold Boshan cap.

sentences.zh: 四時畋、出宮，服通天冠，並赤舄。

translations.literal: Four-season hunt, leaving palace: tongtian cap, all red shoes.
translations.idiomatic: Four-season hunt and leaving palace: tongtian cap, all red shoes.

sentences.zh: 明堂則五時俱通天冠，各以其色服。

translations.literal: Bright Hall then five seasons all tongtian cap, each its color dress.
translations.idiomatic: Bright Hall then five seasons all tongtian cap, each its color dress.

sentences.zh: 東、西堂舉哀，服白帢。

translations.literal: East-west hall expressing mourning: white cap.
translations.idiomatic: East-west hall expressing mourning: white cap.

sentences.zh: 天子六璽：文曰「皇帝行璽」，封常行詔敕則用之。

translations.literal: Son of Heaven six seals: text reads Emperor Traveling Seal—for sealing regular edicts and orders.
translations.idiomatic: Son of Heaven six seals: text reads "Emperor Traveling Seal"—for sealing regular edicts and orders.

sentences.zh: 「皇帝之璽」，賜諸王書則用之。

translations.literal: Emperor's Seal—for bestowing letters to kings.
translations.idiomatic: "Emperor's Seal"—for bestowing letters to kings.

sentences.zh: 「皇帝信璽」，下銅獸符，發諸州征鎮兵，下竹使符，拜代徵召諸州刺史，則用之。

translations.literal: Emperor Trust Seal—for issuing bronze beast tallies dispatching troops from prefectures, bamboo envoy tallies summoning prefectural governors.
translations.idiomatic: "Emperor Trust Seal"—for issuing bronze beast tallies dispatching troops from prefectures and bamboo envoy tallies summoning prefectural governors.

sentences.zh: 並白玉為之，方一寸二分，螭獸鈕。

translations.literal: All white jade made, square one cun two fen, dragon-beast knob.
translations.idiomatic: All white jade made, square one cun two fen, dragon-beast knob.

sentences.zh: 「天子行璽」，封拜外國則用之。

translations.literal: Son of Heaven Traveling Seal—for sealing enfeoffment of foreign states.
translations.idiomatic: "Son of Heaven Traveling Seal"—for sealing enfeoffment of foreign states.

sentences.zh: 「天子之璽」，賜諸外國書則用之。

translations.literal: Son of Heaven's Seal—for bestowing letters to foreign states.
translations.idiomatic: "Son of Heaven's Seal"—for bestowing letters to foreign states.

sentences.zh: 「天子信璽」，發兵外國，若徵召外國，及有事鬼神，則用之。

translations.literal: Son of Heaven Trust Seal—for dispatching troops to foreign states, summoning foreign states, and matters concerning spirits.
translations.idiomatic: "Son of Heaven Trust Seal"—for dispatching troops to foreign states, summoning foreign states, and matters concerning spirits.

sentences.zh: 並黃金為之，方一寸二分，螭獸鈕。

translations.literal: All gold made, square one cun two fen, dragon-beast knob.
translations.idiomatic: All gold made, square one cun two fen, dragon-beast knob.

sentences.zh: 又有傳國璽，白玉為之，方四寸，螭獸鈕，上交五蟠螭，隱起鳥篆書。

translations.literal: Also Heirloom Seal, white jade made, square four cun, dragon-beast knob, above five coiled dragons, hidden raised bird seal script.
translations.idiomatic: Also Heirloom Seal, white jade made, square four cun, dragon-beast knob, above five coiled dragons, hidden raised bird seal script.

sentences.zh: 文曰「受天之命，皇帝壽昌」，凡八字。

translations.literal: Text reads Receiving Heaven's Mandate, Emperor Long Life—in all eight characters.
translations.idiomatic: Text reads "Receiving Heaven's Mandate, Emperor Long Life"—in all eight characters.

sentences.zh: 在六璽外，唯封禪以封石函。

translations.literal: Outside the six seals, only feng and shan to seal stone casket.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the six seals, only feng and shan to seal stone casket.

sentences.zh: 又有督攝萬機印一鈕，以木為之，長一尺二寸，廣二寸五分。

translations.literal: Also Overseeing All Affairs seal one knob, wood made, one chi two cun long, two cun five fen wide.
translations.idiomatic: Also Overseeing All Affairs seal one knob, wood made, one chi two cun long, two cun five fen wide.

sentences.zh: 背上為鼻鈕，鈕長九寸，厚一寸，廣七分。

translations.literal: Back had nose knob, knob nine cun long, one cun thick, seven fen wide.
translations.idiomatic: Back had nose knob, knob nine cun long, one cun thick, seven fen wide.

sentences.zh: 腹下隱起篆書為「督攝萬機」，凡四字。

translations.literal: Belly below hidden raised seal script Overseeing All Affairs—in all four characters.
translations.idiomatic: Belly below hidden raised seal script "Overseeing All Affairs"—in all four characters.

sentences.zh: 此印常在內，唯以印籍縫。

translations.literal: This seal always inside, only used to seal register stitching.
translations.idiomatic: This seal always inside, only used to seal register stitching.

sentences.zh: 用則左戶郎中、度支尚書奏取，印訖輸內。

translations.literal: When used, Left Household Central Commandant and Revenue Master of Writing memorialized to take, after sealing returned inside.
translations.idiomatic: When used, Left Household Central Commandant and Revenue Master of Writing memorialized to take; after sealing returned inside.

sentences.zh: 皇太子平冕，黑介幘，垂白珠九旒，飾以三采玉，以組為纓，色如其綬，金璽，朱綬，四采，赤黃縹紺。

translations.literal: Crown Prince flat crown, black jie cap, hanging white pearl nine tassels, ornamented with three-color jade, cords as chin strap color like sash, gold seal, vermilion sash, four colors red yellow light blue dark blue.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince flat crown, black jie cap, hanging white pearl nine tassels, ornamented with three-color jade, cords as chin strap color like sash, gold seal, vermilion sash, four colors red yellow light blue dark blue.

sentences.zh: 綬朱質，長二丈一尺，三百二十首，廣九寸。

translations.literal: Sash vermilion substance, two zhang one chi long, three hundred twenty tassel, nine cun wide.
translations.idiomatic: Sash vermilion substance, two zhang one chi long, three hundred twenty tassel, nine cun wide.

sentences.zh: 小綬長三尺二寸，與綬同色，而首半之。

translations.literal: Small sash three chi two cun long, same color as sash, tassel half.
translations.idiomatic: Small sash three chi two cun long, same color as sash, tassel half.

sentences.zh: 袞服，同乘輿而九章，絳紱，佩瑜玉，玉具劍、火珠標首，絳袴襪，赤舄。

translations.literal: Dragon robe same as imperial carriage but nine emblems, cinnabar strap, wearing fine jade, jade-fitted sword fire-pearl head, cinnabar trousers socks, red shoes.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon robe same as imperial carriage but nine emblems, cinnabar strap, wearing fine jade, jade-fitted sword fire-pearl head, cinnabar trousers and socks, red shoes.

sentences.zh: 非謁廟則不服。

translations.literal: Not visiting temple then not worn.
translations.idiomatic: Not visiting temple then not worn.

sentences.zh: 未加元服，則空頂黑介幘，雙童髻，雙玉導。

translations.literal: Before receiving capping ceremony then open-topped black jie cap, double youth topknot, double jade guides.
translations.idiomatic: Before receiving capping ceremony then open-topped black jie cap, double youth topknot, double jade guides.

sentences.zh: 中舍人執遠遊冠以從。

translations.literal: Palace attendant held far-wandering cap and followed.
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendant held far-wandering cap and followed.

sentences.zh: 其遠遊三梁冠，黑介幘，翠緌纓，絳紗袍，皁緣中單，黑舄。

translations.literal: Far-wandering three-ribbed cap, black jie cap, kingfisher tassel chin strap, cinnabar gauze robe, black-trimmed inner robe, black shoes.
translations.idiomatic: Far-wandering three-ribbed cap, black jie cap, kingfisher tassel chin strap, cinnabar gauze robe, black-trimmed inner robe, black shoes.

sentences.zh: 大朝所服，亦服進賢三梁冠，黑介幘，皁朝服，絳緣中單，玄舄。

translations.literal: Great court dress also advance-the-worthy three-ribbed cap, black jie cap, black court dress, cinnabar-trimmed inner single garment, dark shoes.
translations.idiomatic: Great court dress also advance-the-worthy three-ribbed cap, black jie cap, black court dress, cinnabar-trimmed inner single garment, dark shoes.

sentences.zh: 為宮臣舉哀，白帢，單衣，烏皮履。

translations.literal: Expressing mourning for palace officials: white cap, single garment, black leather shoes.
translations.idiomatic: Expressing mourning for palace officials: white cap, single garment, black leather shoes.

sentences.zh: 未加元服，則素服。

translations.literal: Before receiving capping ceremony then plain dress.
translations.idiomatic: Before receiving capping ceremony then plain dress.

sentences.zh: 皇太子璽，黃金為之，方一寸，龜鈕，文曰「皇太子璽」。

translations.literal: Crown Prince seal, gold made, square one cun, turtle knob, text reads Crown Prince Seal.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince seal, gold made, square one cun, turtle knob, text reads "Crown Prince Seal."

sentences.zh: 宮中大事用璽，小事用門下典書坊印。

translations.literal: Palace great affairs used seal; minor affairs used gate Secretariat Record Bureau seal.
translations.idiomatic: Palace great affairs used seal; minor affairs used gate Secretariat Record Bureau seal.

sentences.zh: 諸公卿平冕，黑介幘，青珠為旒，上公九，三公八，諸卿六，以組為纓，色如其綬。

translations.literal: Dukes and ministers flat crown, black jie cap, blue pearl tassels: upper duke nine, three dukes eight, ministers six, cords as chin strap color like sash.
translations.idiomatic: Dukes and ministers flat crown, black jie cap, blue pearl tassels: upper duke nine, three dukes eight, ministers six, cords as chin strap color like sash.

sentences.zh: 衣皆玄上纁下。

translations.literal: Robes all black above vermilion below.
translations.idiomatic: Robes all black above vermilion below.

sentences.zh: 三公山龍八章，降皇太子一等，九卿藻火六章，唯郊祀天地宗廟服之。

translations.literal: Three dukes mountain dragon eight emblems, one rank below Crown Prince; Nine Ministers waterweed fire six emblems—only suburban sacrifice Heaven Earth ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Three dukes mountain dragon eight emblems, one rank below Crown Prince; Nine Ministers waterweed fire six emblems—only suburban sacrifice to Heaven, Earth, and ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 遠遊三梁，諸王所服。

translations.literal: Far-wandering three-ribbed—what princes wore.
translations.idiomatic: Far-wandering three-ribbed—what princes wore.

sentences.zh: 其未冠，則空頂黑介幘。

translations.literal: Those not yet capped then open-topped black jie cap.
translations.idiomatic: Those not yet capped then open-topped black jie cap.

sentences.zh: 開國公、侯、伯、子、男及五等散爵未冠者，通如之。

translations.literal: Duke, marquis, viscount, baron who founded states and five-rank unenfeoffed nobles not yet capped—all likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Duke, marquis, viscount, and baron who founded states and five-rank unenfeoffed nobles not yet capped—all likewise.

sentences.zh: 進賢冠，文官二品已上，並三梁，四品已上，並兩梁，五品已下，流外九品已上，皆一梁。

translations.literal: Advance-the-worthy cap: civil officials second rank and above all three-ribbed; fourth rank and above all two-ribbed; fifth rank and below, outside ranks ninth rank and above all one-ribbed.
translations.idiomatic: Advance-the-worthy cap: civil officials second rank and above all three-ribbed; fourth rank and above all two-ribbed; fifth rank and below and outside ranks ninth rank and above all one-ribbed.

sentences.zh: 致事者，通著委貌冠。

translations.literal: Retired officials universally wore appearance-deferring cap.
translations.idiomatic: Retired officials universally wore appearance-deferring cap.

sentences.zh: 主兵官及侍臣，通著武弁。

translations.literal: Military officers and attendants universally wore military cap.
translations.idiomatic: Military officers and attendants universally wore military cap.

sentences.zh: 侍臣加貂璫。

translations.literal: Attendants added sable ornament.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants added sable ornament.

sentences.zh: 御史、大理著法冠。

translations.literal: Censors and Court of Justice wore law cap.
translations.idiomatic: Censors and Court of Justice wore law cap.

sentences.zh: 諸謁者、太子中導客舍人，著高山冠。

translations.literal: All Masters of Ceremonies, Crown Prince ushers and attendants wore lofty mountain cap.
translations.idiomatic: All Masters of Ceremonies, Crown Prince ushers and attendants wore lofty mountain cap.

sentences.zh: 宮門僕射、殿門吏、亭長、太子率更寺、宮門督、太子內坊察非吏、諸門吏等，皆著卻非冠。

translations.literal: Palace gate Attendants-in-Ordinary, hall clerks, pavilion chiefs, Crown Prince Director of Ceremonial Affairs, palace gate supervisors, Crown Prince inside bureau inspectors, various gate clerks—all wore quefei cap.
translations.idiomatic: Palace gate Attendants-in-Ordinary, hall clerks, pavilion chiefs, Crown Prince Director of Ceremonial Affairs, palace gate supervisors, Crown Prince inside bureau inspectors, and various gate clerks—all wore quefei cap.

sentences.zh: 羽林、武賁，著鶡冠。

translations.literal: Forest Guard and Martial Guard wore he cap.
translations.idiomatic: Forest Guard and Martial Guard wore he cap.

sentences.zh: 錄令已下，尚書以上，著納言幘。

translations.literal: Director and below, Masters of Writing and above wore remonstrance cap.
translations.idiomatic: Director and below, Masters of Writing and above wore remonstrance cap.

sentences.zh: 又有赤幘，卑賤者所服。

translations.literal: Also red headcloth—what base persons wore.
translations.idiomatic: Also red headcloth—what base persons wore.

sentences.zh: 救日蝕，文武官皆免冠，著赤介幘，對朝服。

translations.literal: Saving solar eclipse, civil and military officials all removed caps, wore red jie cap, facing court dress.
translations.idiomatic: Saving solar eclipse, civil and military officials all removed caps, wore red jie cap, facing court dress.

sentences.zh: 賤者平巾，赤幘，示威武，以助于陽也。

translations.literal: Base persons flat cap, red headcloth, displaying martial power to assist yang.
translations.idiomatic: Base persons flat cap, red headcloth, displaying martial power to assist yang.

sentences.zh: 止雨亦服之。

translations.literal: Stopping rain also wore it.
translations.idiomatic: Stopping rain also wore it.

sentences.zh: 請雨則服緗幘，東耕則服青幘，庖人則服綠幘。

translations.literal: Praying for rain then wore light red headcloth; east plowing then green headcloth; kitchen staff then green headcloth.
translations.idiomatic: Praying for rain then wore light red headcloth; east plowing then green headcloth; kitchen staff then green headcloth.

sentences.zh: 印綬，二品已上，並金章，紫綬；

translations.literal: Seals and sashes: second rank and above all gold seal purple sash;
translations.idiomatic: Seals and sashes: second rank and above all gold seal purple sash;

sentences.zh: 三品銀章，青綬；

translations.literal: Third rank silver seal blue sash;
translations.idiomatic: Third rank silver seal blue sash;

sentences.zh: 三品已上，凡是五省官及中侍中省，皆為印，不為章。

translations.literal: Third rank and above, all Five Bureaus officials and Central Attendant Bureau all seals not insignia.
translations.idiomatic: Third rank and above, all Five Bureaus officials and Central Attendant Bureau all seals not insignia.

sentences.zh: 四品得印者，銀印，青綬；

translations.literal: Fourth rank receiving seal: silver seal blue sash;
translations.idiomatic: Fourth rank receiving seal: silver seal blue sash;

sentences.zh: 五品、六品得印者，銅印，墨綬，四品已下，凡是開國子、男及五等散品名號侯，皆為銀章，不為印。

translations.literal: Fifth and sixth rank receiving seal: bronze seal black sash; fourth rank and below, all founding viscounts and barons and five-rank unenfeoffed nominal marquis all silver insignia not seal.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth and sixth rank receiving seal: bronze seal black sash; fourth rank and below, all founding viscounts and barons and five-rank unenfeoffed nominal marquis all silver insignia not seal.

sentences.zh: 七品、八品、九品得印者，銅印，黃綬。

translations.literal: Seventh, eighth, ninth rank receiving seal: bronze seal yellow sash.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, eighth, and ninth rank receiving seal: bronze seal yellow sash.

sentences.zh: 金銀章印及銅印，並方一寸，皆龜鈕。

translations.literal: Gold silver insignia and bronze seal all square one cun, all turtle knobs.
translations.idiomatic: Gold silver insignia and bronze seal all square one cun, all turtle knobs.

sentences.zh: 東西南北四籓諸國王章，上籓用中金，中籓用下金，下籓用銀，並方寸，龜鈕。

translations.literal: East south west north four frontier kingdom seals: upper frontier middle gold, middle frontier lower gold, lower frontier silver, all square one cun, turtle knobs.
translations.idiomatic: East south west north four frontier kingdom seals: upper frontier middle gold, middle frontier lower gold, lower frontier silver, all square one cun, turtle knobs.

sentences.zh: 佐官唯公府長史、尚書二丞，給印綬。

translations.literal: Assistant officials only ducal office chief clerk and Masters of Writing two assistants given seal sash.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant officials only ducal office chief clerk and Masters of Writing two assistants given seal sash.

sentences.zh: 六品已下，九品已上，唯當曹為官長者給印。

translations.literal: Sixth rank and below, ninth rank and above—only current bureau chiefs given seal.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth rank and below, ninth rank and above—only current bureau chiefs given seal.

sentences.zh: 余自非長官，雖位尊，並不給。

translations.literal: Others not chiefs, though high rank, all not given.
translations.idiomatic: Others not chiefs, though high rank, all not given.

sentences.zh: 諸王纁朱綬，四采，赤黃縹紺，純朱質，纁文織，長二丈一尺，二百四十首，廣九寸。

translations.literal: Princes light vermilion sash, four colors red yellow light blue dark blue, pure vermilion substance, light vermilion pattern weave, two zhang one chi long, two hundred forty tassel, nine cun wide.
translations.idiomatic: Princes light vermilion sash, four colors red yellow light blue dark blue, pure vermilion substance, light vermilion pattern weave, two zhang one chi long, two hundred forty tassel, nine cun wide.

sentences.zh: 開國郡縣公、散郡縣公，玄朱綬，四采，玄赤縹紺，朱質，玄文織，長一丈八尺，百八十首，廣八寸。

translations.literal: Founding commandery and district duke, unenfeoffed commandery and district duke: dark vermilion sash, four colors dark red light blue dark blue, vermilion substance, dark pattern weave, one zhang eight chi long, one hundred eighty tassel, eight cun wide.
translations.idiomatic: Founding commandery and district duke, unenfeoffed commandery and district duke: dark vermilion sash, four colors dark red light blue dark blue, vermilion substance, dark pattern weave, one zhang eight chi long, one hundred eighty tassel, eight cun wide.

sentences.zh: 開國縣侯伯、散縣侯伯，青朱綬，四采，青赤白縹，朱質，青文織，長一丈六尺，百四十首，廣七寸。

translations.literal: Founding district marquis and viscount, unenfeoffed district marquis and viscount: blue vermilion sash, four colors blue red white light blue, vermilion substance, blue pattern weave, one zhang six chi long, one hundred forty tassel, seven cun wide.
translations.idiomatic: Founding district marquis and viscount, unenfeoffed district marquis and viscount: blue vermilion sash, four colors blue red white light blue, vermilion substance, blue pattern weave, one zhang six chi long, one hundred forty tassel, seven cun wide.

sentences.zh: 開國縣子男、散縣子男、名號侯、開國鄉男，素朱綬，三采，青赤白，朱質，白文織，長一丈四尺，百二十首，廣六寸。

translations.literal: Founding district viscount and baron, unenfeoffed district viscount and baron, nominal marquis, founding township baron: plain vermilion sash, three colors blue red white, vermilion substance, white pattern weave, one zhang four chi long, one hundred twenty tassel, six cun wide.
translations.idiomatic: Founding district viscount and baron, unenfeoffed district viscount and baron, nominal marquis, founding township baron: plain vermilion sash, three colors blue red white, vermilion substance, white pattern weave, one zhang four chi long, one hundred twenty tassel, six cun wide.

sentences.zh: 一品、二品，紫綬，三采，紫黃赤，純紫質，長一丈八尺，百八十首，廣八寸。

translations.literal: First and second rank, purple sash, three colors purple yellow red, pure purple substance, one zhang eight chi long, one hundred eighty tassel, eight cun wide.
translations.idiomatic: First and second rank, purple sash, three colors purple yellow red, pure purple substance, one zhang eight chi long, one hundred eighty tassel, eight cun wide.

sentences.zh: 三品、四品，青綬，三采，青白紅，純青質，長一丈六尺，百四十首，廣七寸。

translations.literal: Third and fourth rank, blue sash, three colors blue white red, pure blue substance, one zhang six chi long, one hundred forty tassel, seven cun wide.
translations.idiomatic: Third and fourth rank, blue sash, three colors blue white red, pure blue substance, one zhang six chi long, one hundred forty tassel, seven cun wide.

sentences.zh: 五品、六品，墨綬，二采，青紺，純紺質，長一丈四尺，百首，廣六寸。

translations.literal: Fifth and sixth rank, black sash, two colors blue dark blue, pure dark blue substance, one zhang four chi long, one hundred tassel, six cun wide.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth and sixth rank, black sash, two colors blue dark blue, pure dark blue substance, one zhang four chi long, one hundred tassel, six cun wide.

sentences.zh: 七品、八品、九品，黃綬，二采，黃白，純黃質，長一丈二尺，六十首，廣五寸。

translations.literal: Seventh, eighth, ninth rank, yellow sash, two colors yellow white, pure yellow substance, one zhang two chi long, sixty tassel, five cun wide.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, eighth, and ninth rank, yellow sash, two colors yellow white, pure yellow substance, one zhang two chi long, sixty tassel, five cun wide.

sentences.zh: 官品從第二已上，小綬間得施玉環。

translations.literal: From second rank up, small sash could have jade ring.
translations.idiomatic: From second rank up, small sash could have jade ring.

sentences.zh: 凡綬，先合單紡為一絲，絲四為一扶，扶五為一首，首五成一文。

translations.literal: All sashes first combined single spun into one thread, four threads one fu, five fu one tassel, five tassel one pattern.
translations.idiomatic: All sashes first combined single spun into one thread, four threads one fu, five fu one tassel, five tassel one pattern.

sentences.zh: 采純為質。

translations.literal: Colors pure as substance.
translations.idiomatic: Colors pure as substance.

sentences.zh: 首多者絲細，首少者絲粗。

translations.literal: Many tassel fine thread; few tassel coarse thread.
translations.idiomatic: Many tassel fine thread; few tassel coarse thread.

sentences.zh: 官有綬者，則有紛，皆長八尺，廣三寸，各隨綬色。

translations.literal: Offices with sash then had fringe, all eight chi long three cun wide, each following sash color.
translations.idiomatic: Offices with sash then had fringe, all eight chi long three cun wide, each following sash color.

sentences.zh: 若服朝服則佩綬，服公服則佩紛。

translations.literal: If wearing court dress then wore sash; if wearing public dress then wore fringe.
translations.idiomatic: If wearing court dress then wore sash; if wearing public dress then wore fringe.

sentences.zh: 官無綬者，不合佩紛。

translations.literal: Offices without sash should not wear fringe.
translations.idiomatic: Offices without sash should not wear fringe.

sentences.zh: 鞶囊，二品已上金縷，三品金銀縷，四品銀縷，五品、六品彩縷，七、八、九品彩縷，獸爪鞶。

translations.literal: Purse: second rank and above gold thread; third rank gold-silver thread; fourth rank silver thread; fifth and sixth rank colored thread; seventh, eighth, ninth rank colored thread, beast-claw purse.
translations.idiomatic: Purse: second rank and above gold thread; third rank gold-silver thread; fourth rank silver thread; fifth and sixth rank colored thread; seventh, eighth, and ninth rank colored thread, beast-claw purse.

sentences.zh: 官無印綬者，並不合佩鞶囊及爪。

translations.literal: Offices without seal sash all should not wear purse and claw.
translations.idiomatic: Offices without seal sash all should not wear purse and claw.

sentences.zh: 一品，玉具劍，佩山玄玉。

translations.literal: First rank, jade-fitted sword, wearing mountain dark jade.
translations.idiomatic: First rank, jade-fitted sword, wearing mountain dark jade.

sentences.zh: 二品，金裝劍，佩水蒼玉。

translations.literal: Second rank, gold-mounted sword, wearing water-dark jade.
translations.idiomatic: Second rank, gold-mounted sword, wearing water-dark jade.

sentences.zh: 三品及開國子男、五等散品名號侯雖四、五品，並銀裝劍，佩水蒼玉。

translations.literal: Third rank and founding viscount and baron, five-rank unenfeoffed nominal marquis though fourth fifth rank—all silver-mounted sword, wearing water-dark jade.
translations.idiomatic: Third rank and founding viscount and baron, five-rank unenfeoffed nominal marquis though fourth fifth rank—all silver-mounted sword, wearing water-dark jade.

sentences.zh: 侍中已下，通直郎已上，陪位則像劍。

translations.literal: From Attendant-in-Ordinary down, Direct Communication Gentleman up—attending seat then ceremonial sword.
translations.idiomatic: From Attendant-in-Ordinary down, Direct Communication Gentleman up—attending seat then ceremonial sword.

sentences.zh: 帶真劍者，入宗廟及升殿，若在仗內，皆解劍。

translations.literal: Those bearing real sword entering ancestral temple and ascending hall—if in guard formation all removed sword.
translations.idiomatic: Those bearing real sword entering ancestral temple and ascending hall—if in guard formation all removed sword.

sentences.zh: 一品及散郡公、開國公侯伯，皆雙佩。

translations.literal: First rank and unenfeoffed commandery duke, founding duke marquis viscount—all double girdle ornaments.
translations.idiomatic: First rank and unenfeoffed commandery duke, founding duke marquis viscount—all double girdle ornaments.

sentences.zh: 二品、三品及開國子男、五等散品名號侯，皆雙佩。

translations.literal: Second and third rank and founding viscount baron, five-rank unenfeoffed nominal marquis—all double girdle ornaments.
translations.idiomatic: Second and third rank and founding viscount baron, five-rank unenfeoffed nominal marquis—all double girdle ornaments.

sentences.zh: 綬亦如之。

translations.literal: Sash likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Sash likewise.

sentences.zh: 百官朝服公服，皆執手板。

translations.literal: All officials court dress public dress all held hand board.
translations.idiomatic: All officials court dress and public dress all held hand board.

sentences.zh: 尚書錄令、僕射、吏部尚書，手板頭復有白筆，以紫皮裹之，名曰笏。

translations.literal: Director of Masters of Writing, Vice Director, Director of Personnel hand board head again had white brush, purple leather wrapped, called tablet.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Masters of Writing, Vice Director, Director of Personnel hand board head again had white brush, purple leather wrapped, called tablet.

sentences.zh: 朝服綴紫荷，錄令、左僕射左荷，右僕射、吏部尚書右荷。

translations.literal: Court dress attached purple satchel; Director left Vice Director left satchel, right Vice Director and Director of Personnel right satchel.
translations.idiomatic: Court dress attached purple satchel; Director left satchel, left Vice Director left satchel, right Vice Director and Director of Personnel right satchel.

sentences.zh: 七品已上文官朝服，皆簪白筆。

translations.literal: Seventh rank and above civil officials court dress all wore white brush in hair.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh rank and above civil officials court dress all wore white brush in hair.

sentences.zh: 正王公侯伯子男、卿尹及武職，並不簪。

translations.literal: Regular dukes marquises viscounts barons, ministers governors and military offices—all did not wear in hair.
translations.idiomatic: Regular dukes marquises viscounts barons, ministers governors and military offices—all did not wear in hair.

sentences.zh: 朝服，冠、幘各一，絳紗單衣，白紗中單，皁領袖，皁襈，革帶，曲領，方心，蔽膝，白筆、舄、襪，兩綬，劍佩，簪導，鉤灊，為具服。

translations.literal: Court dress: crown, cap each one, cinnabar gauze single garment, white gauze inner single garment, black collar sleeves, black trim, leather belt, curved collar, square heart, apron, white brush shoes socks, two sashes, sword girdle ornaments, hairpin guide, hook pendant—complete dress.
translations.idiomatic: Court dress: crown, cap each one, cinnabar gauze single garment, white gauze inner single garment, black collar sleeves, black trim, leather belt, curved collar, square heart, apron, white brush shoes and socks, two sashes, sword girdle ornaments, hairpin guide, hook pendant—complete dress.

sentences.zh: 七品已上服也。

translations.literal: Seventh rank and above wore.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh rank and above wore.

sentences.zh: 公服，冠、幘，紗單衣，深衣，革帶，假帶，履襪，鉤灊，謂之從省服。

translations.literal: Public dress: crown, cap, gauze single garment, deep garment, leather belt, false belt, shoes socks, hook pendant—called reduced dress.
translations.idiomatic: Public dress: crown, cap, gauze single garment, deep garment, leather belt, false belt, shoes and socks, hook pendant—called reduced dress.

sentences.zh: 八品已下，流外四品已上服也。

translations.literal: Eighth rank and below, outside ranks fourth rank and above wore.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth rank and below and outside ranks fourth rank and above wore.

sentences.zh: 流外五品已下，九品已上，皆著褠衣為公服。

translations.literal: Outside ranks fifth rank and below, ninth rank and above all wore collar garment as public dress.
translations.idiomatic: Outside ranks fifth rank and below and ninth rank and above all wore collar garment as public dress.

sentences.zh: 皇后璽、綬、佩同乘輿，假髻，步搖，十二鈿，八雀九華。

translations.literal: Empress seal sash girdle ornaments same as imperial carriage, false topknot, step-sway, twelve studs, eight finches nine splendors.
translations.idiomatic: Empress seal sash girdle ornaments same as imperial carriage, false topknot, step-sway, twelve studs, eight finches nine splendors.

sentences.zh: 助祭朝會以褘衣，祠郊禖以褕狄，小宴以闕狄，親蠶以鞠衣，禮見皇帝以展衣，宴居以褖衣。

translations.literal: Assisting sacrifice court assembly with hui robe, suburban altar prayer with yu-di, minor banquet with que-di, personal silkworm with ju robe, ritual audience with emperor with zhan robe, leisure with tuan robe.
translations.idiomatic: Assisting sacrifice court assembly with hui robe, suburban altar prayer with yu-di, minor banquet with que-di, personal silkworm with ju robe, ritual audience with emperor with zhan robe, leisure with tuan robe.

sentences.zh: 六服俱有蔽膝、織成緄帶。

translations.literal: Six robes all had apron, woven wrapped belt.
translations.idiomatic: Six robes all had apron and woven wrapped belt.

sentences.zh: 皇太后、皇后璽，並以白玉為之，方一寸二分，螭獸鈕，文各如其號。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager and Empress seals all white jade made, square one cun two fen, dragon-beast knob, text each according to title.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager and Empress seals all white jade made, square one cun two fen, dragon-beast knob, text each according to title.

sentences.zh: 璽不行用，有令，則太后以宮名衛尉印，皇后則以長秋印。

translations.literal: Seals not used for travel; if order then Empress Dowager used palace name Guard Commandant seal, Empress then Director of Palace Domestic Service seal.
translations.idiomatic: Seals not used for travel; if order then Empress Dowager used palace name Guard Commandant seal, Empress then Director of Palace Domestic Service seal.

sentences.zh: 內外命婦從五品已上，蔽髻，唯以鈿數花釵多少為品秩。

translations.literal: Inner and outer titled ladies from fifth rank up, covered topknot—only stud count and flower hairpin amount marked rank.
translations.idiomatic: Inner and outer titled ladies from fifth rank up, covered topknot—only stud count and flower hairpin amount marked rank.

sentences.zh: 二品已上金玉飾，三品已下金飾。

translations.literal: Second rank and above gold jade ornament; third rank and below gold ornament.
translations.idiomatic: Second rank and above gold jade ornament; third rank and below gold ornament.

sentences.zh: 內命婦、左右昭儀、三夫人視一品，假髻，九鈿，金章，紫綬，服褕翟，雙佩山玄玉。

translations.literal: Inner titled ladies Left Right Bright Conduct Three Ladies treated as first rank: false topknot nine studs, gold insignia purple sash, yu-di robe, double mountain dark jade.
translations.idiomatic: Inner titled ladies Left Right Bright Conduct Three Ladies treated as first rank: false topknot nine studs, gold insignia purple sash, yu-di robe, double mountain dark jade.

sentences.zh: 九嬪視三品，五鈿蔽髻，銀章，青綬，服鞠衣，佩水蒼玉。

translations.literal: Nine Concubines treated as third rank, five stud covered topknot, silver insignia blue sash, ju robe, water-dark jade.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Concubines treated as third rank, five stud covered topknot, silver insignia blue sash, ju robe, water-dark jade.

sentences.zh: 世婦視四品，三鈿，銀印，青綬，服展衣，無佩。

translations.literal: Palace ladies treated as fourth rank, three studs, silver seal blue sash, zhan robe, no girdle ornament.
translations.idiomatic: Palace ladies treated as fourth rank, three studs, silver seal blue sash, zhan robe, no girdle ornament.

sentences.zh: 八十一御女視五品，一鈿，銅印，墨綬，服褖衣。

translations.literal: Eighty-one palace women treated as fifth rank, one stud, bronze seal black sash, tuan robe.
translations.idiomatic: Eighty-one palace women treated as fifth rank, one stud, bronze seal black sash, tuan robe.

sentences.zh: 又有宮人女官服制，第二品七鈿蔽髻，服闕翟；

translations.literal: Also palace women female official dress system: second rank seven stud covered topknot, que-di robe;
translations.idiomatic: Also palace women female official dress system: second rank seven stud covered topknot, que-di robe;

sentences.zh: 三品五鈿，鞠衣；

translations.literal: Third rank five studs, ju robe;
translations.idiomatic: Third rank five studs, ju robe;

translations.literal: Fourth rank three studs, zhan robe;
translations.idiomatic: Fourth rank three studs, zhan robe;

translations.literal: Fifth rank one stud, tuan robe;

translations.literal: Sixth rank tuan robe;
translations.idiomatic: Sixth rank tuan robe;

translations.literal: Seventh rank blue gauze public dress.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh rank blue gauze public dress.

sentences.zh: 俱大首髻。

translations.literal: All great topknot.
translations.idiomatic: All great topknot.

sentences.zh: 八品、九品，俱青紗公服，偏髾髻。

translations.literal: Eighth and ninth rank all blue gauze public dress, side topknot.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth and ninth rank all blue gauze public dress, side topknot.

sentences.zh: 皇太子妃璽、綬、佩同皇太子，假髻，步搖，九鈿，服褕翟。

translations.literal: Crown Princess Consort seal sash girdle ornaments same as Crown Prince, false topknot step-sway nine studs, yu-di robe.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Princess Consort seal sash girdle ornaments same as Crown Prince, false topknot step-sway nine studs, yu-di robe.

sentences.zh: 從蠶則青紗公服。

translations.literal: Following silkworm then blue gauze public dress.
translations.idiomatic: Following silkworm then blue gauze public dress.

sentences.zh: 皇太子妃璽，以黃金，方一寸，龜鈕，文曰「皇太子妃之璽」。

translations.literal: Crown Princess Consort seal, gold, square one cun, turtle knob, text reads Crown Princess Consort's Seal.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Princess Consort seal, gold, square one cun, turtle knob, text reads "Crown Princess Consort's Seal."

translations.literal: If sealing letter then used inner bureau seal.
translations.idiomatic: If sealing letter then used inner bureau seal.

sentences.zh: 郡長公主、公主、王國太妃、妃，纁朱綬，髻章服佩同內命婦一品。

translations.literal: Commandery Grand Princess, Princess, Kingdom Grand Consort, Consort: light vermilion sash, topknot insignia dress girdle ornaments same as inner titled lady first rank.
translations.idiomatic: Commandery Grand Princess, Princess, Kingdom Grand Consort, Consort: light vermilion sash, topknot insignia dress girdle ornaments same as inner titled lady first rank.

sentences.zh: 郡長君七鈿蔽髻，玄朱綬，闕翟，章佩與公主同。

translations.literal: Commandery Grand Lady seven stud covered topknot, dark vermilion sash, que-di, insignia girdle ornaments same as princess.
translations.idiomatic: Commandery Grand Lady seven stud covered topknot, dark vermilion sash, que-di, insignia girdle ornaments same as princess.

sentences.zh: 郡君、縣主，佩水蒼玉，餘與郡長君同。

translations.literal: Commandery Lady, District Lady wearing water-dark jade, rest same as Commandery Grand Lady.
translations.idiomatic: Commandery Lady, District Lady wearing water-dark jade, rest same as Commandery Grand Lady.

sentences.zh: 太子良娣視九嬪服。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Good Companion treated as Nine Concubines dress.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Good Companion treated as Nine Concubines dress.

sentences.zh: 縣主青朱綬，餘與良娣同。

translations.literal: District Lady blue vermilion sash, rest same as Good Companion.
translations.idiomatic: District Lady blue vermilion sash, rest same as Good Companion.

sentences.zh: 女侍中五鈿，假金印、紫綬，服鞠衣，佩水蒼玉。

translations.literal: Female Attendant-in-Ordinary five studs, false gold seal purple sash, ju robe, water-dark jade.
translations.idiomatic: Female Attendant-in-Ordinary five studs, false gold seal purple sash, ju robe, water-dark jade.

sentences.zh: 縣君銀章，青朱綬，餘與女侍中同。

translations.literal: District Lady silver insignia blue vermilion sash, rest same as Female Attendant-in-Ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: District Lady silver insignia blue vermilion sash, rest same as Female Attendant-in-Ordinary.

translations.literal: Crown Prince Lady of the Nursery same as palace lady.

translations.idiomatic: Embroidery crown three emblems, robe one emblem skirt two emblems, robe heavier grain, four grades.

translations.literal: Scholars' robes three: first sacrifice cap, second cap, third dark cap.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars' robes three: first sacrifice cap, second cap, third dark cap.

sentences.zh: 玄冠皆玄衣。

translations.literal: Dark cap all dark robes.
translations.idiomatic: Dark cap all dark robes.

sentences.zh: 其裳，上士以玄，中士以黃，下士雜裳，謂前玄後黃也。

translations.literal: Skirt: upper scholar dark, middle scholar yellow, lower scholar mixed skirt—meaning dark front yellow back.
translations.idiomatic: Skirt: upper scholar dark, middle scholar yellow, lower scholar mixed skirt—meaning dark front yellow back.

sentences.zh: 庶士之服一：玄冠。

translations.literal: Common scholars' robes one: dark cap.
translations.idiomatic: Common scholars' robes one: dark cap.

sentences.zh: 庶士，庶人在官，府史之屬。

translations.literal: Common scholars, commoners in office, clerks of bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Common scholars, commoners in office, clerks of bureaus.

sentences.zh: 其服緇衣裳。

translations.literal: Their robes dark cloth garments.
translations.idiomatic: Their robes dark cloth garments.

sentences.zh: 後令文武俱著常服，冠形如魏帢，無簪有纓。

translations.literal: Later ordered civil and military all wore regular dress, cap form like Wei headcloth, no hairpin with chin strap.
translations.idiomatic: Later ordered civil and military all wore regular dress, cap form like Wei headcloth, no hairpin with chin strap.

sentences.zh: 其凶服皆與庶人同。

translations.literal: Mourning dress all same as commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning dress all same as commoners.

sentences.zh: 其吊服，諸侯于其卿大夫，錫衰；

translations.literal: Mourning dress: feudal lords for their ministers grand masters tin mourning;
translations.idiomatic: Mourning dress: feudal lords for their ministers and grand masters tin mourning;

sentences.zh: 同姓，緦衰；

translations.literal: Same surname hemp mourning;
translations.idiomatic: Same surname hemp mourning;

sentences.zh: 於士，疑衰。

translations.literal: For scholars si mourning.
translations.idiomatic: For scholars si mourning.

sentences.zh: 其當事則弁絰，否則皮弁。

translations.literal: When on duty then cap headband; otherwise skin cap.
translations.idiomatic: When on duty then cap headband; otherwise skin cap.

sentences.zh: 公孤卿大夫之吊服，錫衰弁絰，皮弁亦如之。

translations.literal: Dukes Solitaries ministers grand masters mourning dress tin mourning cap headband, skin cap likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Dukes Solitaries ministers grand masters mourning dress tin mourning cap headband, skin cap likewise.

sentences.zh: 士之吊服，疑衰素裳，當事弁絰，否則徒弁。

translations.literal: Scholars mourning dress si mourning plain skirt, on duty cap headband, otherwise plain cap.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars mourning dress si mourning plain skirt, on duty cap headband, otherwise plain cap.

sentences.zh: 皇后衣十二等。

translations.literal: Empress robes twelve grades.
translations.idiomatic: Empress robes twelve grades.

sentences.zh: 其翟衣六，從皇帝祀郊禖，享先皇，朝皇太后，則服翬衣。

translations.literal: Di robes six: following emperor sacrificing suburban altar prayer, feasting former emperors, audience of Empress Dowager then hui robe.
translations.idiomatic: Di robes six: following emperor sacrificing suburban altar prayer, feasting former emperors, audience of Empress Dowager then hui robe.

sentences.zh: 素質，五色。

translations.literal: Plain substance five colors.
translations.idiomatic: Plain substance five colors.

sentences.zh: 祭陰社，朝命婦，則服騑衣。

translations.literal: Sacrificing yin altar, audience of titled ladies then fei robe.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificing yin altar, audience of titled ladies then fei robe.

sentences.zh: 青質，五色。

translations.literal: Green substance five colors.
translations.idiomatic: Green substance five colors.

sentences.zh: 祭群小祀，受獻繭，則服鷩衣。

translations.literal: Sacrificing minor group sacrifices, receiving offered cocoon then pheasant robe.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificing minor group sacrifices, receiving offered cocoon then pheasant robe.

sentences.zh: 赤色採桑則服鳪衣。

translations.literal: Red color picking mulberry then bo robe.
translations.idiomatic: Red color picking mulberry then bo robe.

sentences.zh: 黃色從皇帝見賓客，聽女教，則服鵫衣。

translations.literal: Yellow color following emperor seeing guests, listening to women's instruction then zhi robe.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow color following emperor seeing guests, listening to women's instruction then zhi robe.

sentences.zh: 白色食命婦，歸寧，則服𦐝衣。

translations.literal: White color feasting titled ladies, returning home then yi robe.
translations.idiomatic: White color feasting titled ladies, returning home then yi robe.

sentences.zh: 玄色俱十有二等，以翬雉為領褾，各有二。

translations.literal: Dark color all twelve grades, hui pheasant as collar border, each two.
translations.idiomatic: Dark color all twelve grades, hui pheasant as collar border, each two.

sentences.zh: 臨婦學及法道門，燕命婦，有時見命婦，則蒼衣。

translations.literal: Visiting women's academy and Gate of the Way and Law, banqueting titled ladies, sometimes seeing titled ladies then dark robe.
translations.idiomatic: Visiting women's academy and Gate of the Way and Law, banqueting titled ladies, sometimes seeing titled ladies then dark robe.

sentences.zh: 春齋及祭還，則青衣。

translations.literal: Spring fasting and sacrifice return then green robe.
translations.idiomatic: Spring fasting and sacrifice return then green robe.

sentences.zh: 夏齋及祭還，則朱衣。

translations.literal: Summer fasting and sacrifice return then vermilion robe.
translations.idiomatic: Summer fasting and sacrifice return then vermilion robe.

sentences.zh: 採桑齋及採桑還，則黃衣。

translations.literal: Mulberry-picking fasting and mulberry-picking return then yellow robe.
translations.idiomatic: Mulberry-picking fasting and mulberry-picking return then yellow robe.

sentences.zh: 秋齋及祭還，則素衣。

translations.literal: Autumn fasting and sacrifice return then white robe.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn fasting and sacrifice return then white robe.

translations.literal: Winter fasting and sacrifice return then dark robe.
translations.idiomatic: Winter fasting and sacrifice return then dark robe.

translations.literal: From green robe down collar border used mutually generating colors.
translations.idiomatic: From green robe down collar border used mutually generating colors.

sentences.zh: 諸公夫人九服，其翟衣雉皆九等，俱以騑雉為領褾，各九。

translations.literal: Feudal lords' ladies nine robes, di robes pheasants all nine grades, all fei pheasant as collar border, each nine.
translations.idiomatic: Feudal lords' ladies nine robes, di robes pheasants all nine grades, all fei pheasant as collar border, each nine.

sentences.zh: 自騑衣已下五，曰騑衣、鷩衣、鳪衣、鵫衣、𦐝衣，並朱衣、黃衣、素衣、玄衣而九。

translations.literal: From fei robe down five: fei robe, pheasant robe, bo robe, zhi robe, yi robe, and vermilion yellow white dark robes making nine.
translations.idiomatic: From fei robe down five: fei robe, pheasant robe, bo robe, zhi robe, yi robe, and vermilion yellow white dark robes making nine.

sentences.zh: 自朱衣而下，其領褾亦同用相生之色。

translations.literal: From vermilion robe down collar border likewise used mutually generating colors.
translations.idiomatic: From vermilion robe down collar border likewise used mutually generating colors.

sentences.zh: 諸侯夫人，自鷩而下八。

translations.literal: Feudal lords' ladies from pheasant down eight.
translations.idiomatic: Feudal lords' ladies from pheasant down eight.

sentences.zh: 其翟衣雉皆八等，俱以鷩雉為領褾。

translations.literal: Di robes pheasants all eight grades, all pheasant pheasant as collar border.
translations.idiomatic: Di robes pheasants all eight grades, all pheasant pheasant as collar border.

sentences.zh: 無騑衣。

translations.literal: No fei robe.
translations.idiomatic: No fei robe.

sentences.zh: 諸伯夫人，自鳪而下七。

translations.literal: Earls' ladies from bo down seven.
translations.idiomatic: Earls' ladies from bo down seven.

sentences.zh: 其翟衣雉皆七等，俱以鳪雉為領襟，又無鵫衣。

translations.literal: Di robes pheasants all seven grades, all bo pheasant as collar border, again no zhi robe.
translations.idiomatic: Di robes pheants all seven grades, all bo pheasant as collar border, again no zhi robe.

sentences.zh: 諸子夫人，自鵫而下六。

translations.literal: Viscounts' ladies from zhi down six.
translations.idiomatic: Viscounts' ladies from zhi down six.

sentences.zh: 其翟衣俱以鵫雉為領褾。

translations.literal: Di robes all zhi pheasant as collar border.
translations.idiomatic: Di robes all zhi pheasant as collar border.

sentences.zh: 又無鳪衣。

translations.literal: Again no bo robe.
translations.idiomatic: Again no bo robe.

sentences.zh: 諸男夫人，自𦐝而下五。

translations.literal: Barons' ladies from yi down five.
translations.idiomatic: Barons' ladies from yi down five.

sentences.zh: 其翟衣雉皆五等，俱以𦐝雉為領褾。

translations.literal: Di robes pheasants all five grades, all yi pheasant as collar border.
translations.idiomatic: Di robes pheasants all five grades, all yi pheasant as collar border.

sentences.zh: 又無鳪衣。

translations.literal: Again no bo robe.
translations.idiomatic: Again no bo robe.

sentences.zh: 三妃，三公夫人之服九：一曰鳪衣，二曰鵫衣、三曰𦐝衣，四曰青衣，五曰朱衣，六曰黃衣，七曰素衣，八曰玄衣，九曰鷩衣。

translations.literal: Three Consorts, Three Dukes' ladies' robes nine: first bo robe, second zhi robe, third yi robe, fourth green robe, fifth vermilion robe, sixth yellow robe, seventh white robe, eighth dark robe, ninth pheasant robe.
translations.idiomatic: Three Consorts, Three Dukes' ladies' robes nine: first bo robe, second zhi robe, third yi robe, fourth green robe, fifth vermilion robe, sixth yellow robe, seventh white robe, eighth dark robe, ninth pheasant robe.

sentences.zh: 似發華皆九樹。

translations.literal: Splendor all nine trees.
translations.idiomatic: Splendor all nine trees.

sentences.zh: 其雉衣亦皆九等，以褾雉為領褾，各九。

translations.literal: Pheasant robes also all nine grades, border pheasant as collar border, each nine.
translations.idiomatic: Pheasant robes also all nine grades, border pheasant as collar border, each nine.

sentences.zh: 三㚤，三孤之內子，自鵫衣而下八。

translations.literal: Three Consorts, Three Solitaries' inner ladies from zhi robe down eight.
translations.idiomatic: Three Consorts, Three Solitaries' inner ladies from zhi robe down eight.

sentences.zh: 雉衣皆八等，以鵫雉為領褾，各八。

translations.literal: Pheasant robes all eight grades, zhi pheasant as collar border, each eight.
translations.idiomatic: Pheasant robes all eight grades, zhi pheasant as collar border, each eight.

sentences.zh: 六嬪，六卿之內子，自𦐝衣而下七。

translations.literal: Six Concubines, Six Ministers' inner ladies from yi robe down seven.
translations.idiomatic: Six Concubines, Six Ministers' inner ladies from yi robe down seven.

sentences.zh: 雉衣皆七等，以𦐝雉為領褾，各七。

translations.literal: Pheasant robes all seven grades, yi pheasant as collar border, each seven.
translations.idiomatic: Pheasant robes all seven grades, yi pheasant as collar border, each seven.

sentences.zh: 上媛，上大夫之孺人，自青衣而下六。

translations.literal: Upper Lady, upper grand master's lady from green robe down six.
translations.idiomatic: Upper Lady, upper grand master's lady from green robe down six.

translations.literal: Middle Lady, middle grand master's lady from vermilion robe down five.
translations.idiomatic: Middle Lady, middle grand master's lady from vermilion robe down five.

translations.literal: Lower Lady, lower grand master's lady from yellow robe down four.
translations.idiomatic: Lower Lady, lower grand master's lady from yellow robe down four.

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Lady, scholar's lady from white robe down three.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Lady, scholar's lady from white robe down three.

translations.literal: Central Palace Six Directors, dark red robe.
translations.idiomatic: Central Palace Six Directors, dark red robe.

translations.literal: Its color red slightly dark
translations.idiomatic: Its color red slightly dark.

translations.literal: Titled rank robes called public dress; rest regular dress called private dress.
translations.idiomatic: Titled rank robes called public dress; rest regular dress called private dress.

sentences.zh: 皇后華皆有十二樹。

translations.literal: Empress splendor all twelve trees.
translations.idiomatic: Empress splendor all twelve trees.

translations.literal: Feudal lords' ladies also all according to mandate number as regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Feudal lords' ladies also all according to mandate number as regulation.

translations.literal: Three Consorts, Three Dukes' ladies and below also each according to mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Three Consorts, Three Dukes' ladies and below also each according to mandate.

translations.literal: One mandate two mandate again all three as regulation.
translations.idiomatic: One mandate and two mandate again all three as regulation.

translations.idiomatic: Empress and feudal lords' ladies' robes all shoes.

translations.literal: Shoes slippers each according to skirt color.

translations.idiomatic: For Consorts, Concubines, Three Dukes' ladies, Solitaries' inner ladies' mourning tin mourning.

translations.idiomatic: Tin ones fifteen sheng taking half.
