translations.literal: Not treating threads, treating cloth, sorrow inside.
translations.idiomatic: Not treating threads, treating cloth, sorrow inside.

translations.literal: For feudal lords' ladies' mourning hemp mourning.
translations.idiomatic: For feudal lords' ladies' mourning hemp mourning.

sentences.zh: 緦亦十五升去其半。

translations.literal: Hemp also fifteen sheng taking half.
translations.idiomatic: Hemp also fifteen sheng taking half.

sentences.zh: 有事其縷，無事其布，哀在外也。

translations.literal: Treating threads not treating cloth, sorrow outside.
translations.idiomatic: Treating threads not treating cloth, sorrow outside.

translations.idiomatic: For Lady, Palace Attendant Lady and grand masters' ladies, scholars' ladies' mourning si mourning.

translations.literal: Fourteen sheng, si between auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen sheng, si between auspicious.

translations.literal: All auspicious hairpin, no head ornament.
translations.idiomatic: All auspicious hairpin, no head ornament.

sentences.zh: 象笄，去首飾。

translations.literal: Elephant hairpin, removed head ornament.
translations.idiomatic: Elephant hairpin, removed head ornament.

translations.literal: Great yin waning then plain dress.
translations.idiomatic: Great yin waning then plain dress.

translations.idiomatic: Dissolving world's yin affairs: feudal lords' ladies and Three Consorts and Three Dukes' ladies and below mourning then five mourning—from hemp up all wore; mourning feudal lords' ladies for ministers' inner ladies and grand masters' ladies tin mourning.

sentences.zh: 於己之同姓之臣，緦衰。

translations.literal: For own same surname ministers hemp mourning.
translations.idiomatic: For own same surname ministers hemp mourning.

sentences.zh: 於士之婦人，疑衰。

translations.literal: For scholars' ladies si mourning.
translations.idiomatic: For scholars' ladies si mourning.

sentences.zh: 皆吉笄，無首。

translations.literal: All auspicious hairpin, no head ornament.
translations.idiomatic: All auspicious hairpin, no head ornament.

sentences.zh: 其三妃已下及媛，三公夫人已下及孺人，其吊服錫衰。

translations.literal: Three Consorts and below and Ladies, Three Dukes' ladies and below and ladies their mourning dress tin mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Three Consorts and below and Ladies, Three Dukes' ladies and below and ladies their mourning dress tin mourning.

sentences.zh: 禦婉及士之婦人，吊服疑衰，疑衰同笄。

translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Lady and scholars' ladies mourning dress si mourning, si mourning same hairpin.

translations.idiomatic: Nine clans and below all bone hairpin.

translations.literal: Knee cover: emperor three emblems dragon fire mountain;
translations.idiomatic: Knee cover: emperor three emblems dragon fire mountain;

sentences.zh: 諸侯二章，去龍；

translations.literal: Feudal lords two emblems removing dragon;
translations.idiomatic: Feudal lords two emblems removing dragon;

sentences.zh: 卿大夫一章，以山。

translations.literal: Ministers grand masters one emblem using mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers and grand masters one emblem using mountain.

sentences.zh: 皆織彩以成之。

translations.literal: All woven colors to complete.
translations.idiomatic: All woven colors to complete.

translations.literal: Emperor eight seals, has Spirit Seal, has Heirloom Seal, all treasured not used.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor eight seals, has Spirit Seal, has Heirloom Seal, all treasured not used.

translations.idiomatic: Spirit Seal shows receiving from Heaven; Heirloom Seal shows receiving from Fortune.

translations.idiomatic: Emperor leaning on screen then placed Spirit Seal before mat right, Heirloom Seal before mat left.

translations.idiomatic: Also six seals.

translations.literal: First Emperor Traveling Seal—for sealing orders to feudal lords and Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: First "Emperor Traveling Seal"—for sealing orders to feudal lords and Three Dukes.

translations.idiomatic: Three Dukes and feudal lords all gold seal, square one cun two fen, eight fen high, turtle knob.

translations.idiomatic: Seventh mandate and above silver, fourth mandate and above bronze, all turtle knobs.
